proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ a b c a' b' c' hc _ h1 h2
  have hs := EuclideanGeometry.similar_of_angle_angle hc h1 h2
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mp hs
  exact ⟨r, hr, h 0 1, h 1 2, h 2 0⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (a b c a' b' c' : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P) → ¬Collinear ℝ ({a', b', c'} : Set P) → EuclideanGeometry.angle a b c = EuclideanGeometry.angle a' b' c' → EuclideanGeometry.angle b c a = EuclideanGeometry.angle b' c' a' → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ dist a b = r * dist a' b' ∧ dist b c = r * dist b' c' ∧ dist c a = r * dist c' a'
